export_evidence: No shipment record retrieved. importkey.com/countries/india/jabsons-foods returned a JavaScript shell with zero data rows (page text: 'Shipments available for JABSONS FOODS, refreshed daily' — a template placeholder, not a record; rows actually seen: 0). volza.com/p/jabsons-foods/ = HTTP 403; eximpedia.app = HTTP 403; trademo.com = HTTP 403; importgenius.com = JS 'Client Challenge' block. No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code could be verified. Only company self-claim found on jabsons.com homepage: 'Exporting to 40+ Countries' — per Rule 5 this is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
domestic_evidence: jabsons.com operates a live D2C store with priced SKUs and stock states (e.g. 'Khari Sing (With Skin) Roasted Peanuts 4.3 Regular price Rs. 100 ... 400 g 200 g Add to cart', 'Shipping Across India*'), which indicates an active domestic sales channel but is a catalogue, not a supply record. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report revenue split could be retrieved (zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com both HTTP 403). GSTIN, turnover and revenue: null — not public in accessible sources.
note: Evidence gathering was blocked: DuckDuckGo/searx search backend returned 'Connection refused' on both queries, and every trade-data aggregator (Volza, Eximpedia, Trademo, ImportGenius) plus both Indian registry mirrors returned 403 or a JS challenge. Therefore export_status is 'unknown', not 'confirmed' and not 'none_found' — the absence of retrieved records here reflects tool failure, not proof that no shipments exist. No export record with date/destination/HS/B-L number was seen, so nothing can be asserted. Declared HS codes (100630, 190540, 190590, 200811) are broadly consistent with the observed product range (roasted peanuts, chikki, khakhra, namkeen) but were not checked against any customs line. No rejection basis found: no evidence of non-existence, liquidation or insolvency; company website is live and transacting. Recommend re-run with a working search backend and a paid Volza/Eximpedia view before any verdict on actual shipments.
